description:
PanLex
	

January 1, 2024 version of PanLex Language Vocabulary with 24,650,274 rows covering 6,152 languages.

	
		
	
	
		Columns
	


vocab: contains the text entry.  
639-3: contains the ISO 639-3 languages tags to allow users to filter on the language(s) of their choice.
639-3_english_name: the English language name associated to the code ISO 639-3. 
var_code: contains a code to differentiate language variants. In practice, this is the code 639-3 + a number.  If 000, it… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lbourdois/panlex.
